AI.conclusion: 提出的系统为早期糖尿病视网膜病变筛查提供了一个可扩展且实用的工具，特别适用于资源受限环境。

title: Global-Local Dual Perception for MLLMs in High-Resolution Text-Rich Image Translation
summary: Text Image Machine Translation (TIMT) aims to translate text embedded in images in the source-language into target-language, requiring synergistic integration of visual perception and linguistic understanding. Existing TIMT methods, whether cascaded pipelines or end-to-end multimodal large language models (MLLMs),struggle with high-resolution text-rich images due to cluttered layouts, diverse fonts, and non-textual distractions, resulting in text omission, semantic drift, and contextual inconsistency. To address these challenges, we propose GLoTran, a global-local dual visual perception framework for MLLM-based TIMT. GLoTran integrates a low-resolution global image with multi-scale region-level text image slices under an instruction-guided alignment strategy, conditioning MLLMs to maintain scene-level contextual consistency while faithfully capturing fine-grained textual details. Moreover, to realize this dual-perception paradigm, we construct GLoD, a large-scale text-rich TIMT dataset comprising 510K high-resolution global-local image-text pairs covering diverse real-world scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GLoTran substantially improves translation completeness and accuracy over state-of-the-art MLLMs, offering a new paradigm for fine-grained TIMT under high-resolution and text-rich conditions.

AI.tldr: GLoTran是一个用于高分辨率文本丰富图像机器翻译的全局-局部双视觉感知框架，通过整合低分辨率全局图像和多尺度区域级文本图像切片，在MLLM中实现场景级上下文一致性和细粒度文本细节捕捉。
AI.motivation: 现有TIMT方法（级联管道或端到端MLLM）在处理高分辨率文本丰富图像时面临挑战，包括杂乱布局、多样字体和非文本干扰，导致文本遗漏、语义漂移和上下文不一致。
AI.method: 提出GLoTran框架，整合低分辨率全局图像和多尺度区域级文本图像切片，采用指令引导对齐策略，使MLLM能够保持场景级上下文一致性同时捕捉细粒度文本细节。构建GLoD数据集（51万高分辨率全局-局部图像-文本对）。
AI.result: 实验表明GLoTran在翻译完整性和准确性方面显著优于现有最先进的MLLM，为高分辨率文本丰富条件下的细粒度TIMT提供了新范式。
AI.conclusion: GLoTran通过全局-局部双视觉感知框架有效解决了高分辨率文本丰富图像翻译中的挑战，在保持上下文一致性的同时准确捕捉文本细节，为TIMT领域提供了创新解决方案。

title: Global-Aware Edge Prioritization for Pose Graph Initialization
summary: The pose graph is a core component of Structure-from-Motion (SfM), where images act as nodes and edges encode relative poses. Since geometric verification is expensive, SfM pipelines restrict the pose graph to a sparse set of candidate edges, making initialization critical. Existing methods rely on image retrieval to connect each image to its $k$ nearest neighbors, treating pairs independently and ignoring global consistency. We address this limitation through the concept of edge prioritization, ranking candidate edges by their utility for SfM. Our approach has three components: (1) a GNN trained with SfM-derived supervision to predict globally consistent edge reliability; (2) multi-minimal-spanning-tree-based pose graph construction guided by these ranks; and (3) connectivity-aware score modulation that reinforces weak regions and reduces graph diameter. This globally informed initialization yields more reliable and compact pose graphs, improving reconstruction accuracy in sparse and high-speed settings and outperforming SOTA retrieval methods on ambiguous scenes. The ode and trained models are available at https://github.com/weitong8591/global_edge_prior.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于边缘优先级排序的全局一致性姿态图初始化方法，通过图神经网络预测边缘可靠性，构建多最小生成树姿态图，改善稀疏和高速场景下的三维重建精度。
AI.motivation: 传统SfM管道依赖图像检索为每个图像连接k个最近邻，这种方法独立处理图像对而忽略全局一致性，导致姿态图初始化质量受限。几何验证成本高昂使得姿态图只能包含稀疏候选边缘，因此初始化方法至关重要。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：1) 使用SfM衍生的监督训练GNN来预测全局一致的边缘可靠性；2) 基于这些排名指导的多最小生成树姿态图构建；3) 连接感知的分数调制机制，强化弱区域并减少图直径。
AI.result: 该方法在稀疏和高速设置下产生了更可靠和紧凑的姿态图，提高了重建精度，在模糊场景中优于最先进的检索方法。代码和训练模型已在GitHub开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过边缘优先级排序实现全局一致性姿态图初始化，能够显著改善SfM系统的重建质量，特别是在具有挑战性的场景中，为姿态图构建提供了更智能的解决方案。

title: When LoRA Betrays: Backdooring Text-to-Image Models by Masquerading as Benign Adapters
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as a leading technique for efficiently fine-tuning text-to-image diffusion models, and its widespread adoption on open-source platforms has fostered a vibrant culture of model sharing and customization. However, the same modular and plug-and-play flexibility that makes LoRA appealing also introduces a broader attack surface. To highlight this risk, we propose Masquerade-LoRA (MasqLoRA), the first systematic attack framework that leverages an independent LoRA module as the attack vehicle to stealthily inject malicious behavior into text-to-image diffusion models. MasqLoRA operates by freezing the base model parameters and updating only the low-rank adapter weights using a small number of "trigger word-target image" pairs. This enables the attacker to train a standalone backdoor LoRA module that embeds a hidden cross-modal mapping: when the module is loaded and a specific textual trigger is provided, the model produces a predefined visual output; otherwise, it behaves indistinguishably from the benign model, ensuring the stealthiness of the attack. Experimental results demonstrate that MasqLoRA can be trained with minimal resource overhead and achieves a high attack success rate of 99.8%. MasqLoRA reveals a severe and unique threat in the AI supply chain, underscoring the urgent need for dedicated defense mechanisms for the LoRA-centric sharing ecosystem.

AI.tldr: MasqLoRA是一种针对LoRA微调扩散模型的新型后门攻击框架，通过独立LoRA模块注入恶意行为，在特定触发词下输出预设图像，其他情况下表现正常
AI.motivation: LoRA技术在文本到图像扩散模型中的广泛应用带来了模型共享和定制的便利，但其模块化和即插即用的特性也扩大了攻击面。为了揭示这种风险，研究者提出了第一个系统性的攻击框架
AI.method: 提出MasqLoRA攻击框架，冻结基础模型参数，仅更新低秩适配器权重，使用少量"触发词-目标图像"对训练独立的恶意LoRA模块，嵌入隐藏的跨模态映射
AI.result: 实验结果表明，MasqLoRA能以最小的资源开销进行训练，攻击成功率高达99.8%，揭示了AI供应链中的严重威胁
AI.conclusion: MasqLoRA暴露了LoRA中心化共享生态系统的独特安全威胁，强调了为这一生态系统开发专门防御机制的紧迫性

title: RobustVisRAG: Causality-Aware Vision-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation under Visual Degradations
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026; Project Page: https://robustvisrag.github.io
summary: Vision-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (VisRAG) leverages vision-language models (VLMs) to jointly retrieve relevant visual documents and generate grounded answers based on multimodal evidence. However, existing VisRAG models degrade in performance when visual inputs suffer from distortions such as blur, noise, low light, or shadow, where semantic and degradation factors become entangled within pretrained visual encoders, leading to errors in both retrieval and generation stages. To address this limitation, we introduce RobustVisRAG, a causality-guided dual-path framework that improves VisRAG robustness while preserving efficiency and zero-shot generalization. RobustVisRAG uses a non-causal path to capture degradation signals through unidirectional attention and a causal path to learn purified semantics guided by these signals. Together with the proposed Non-Causal Distortion Modeling and Causal Semantic Alignment objectives, the framework enforces a clear separation between semantics and degradations, enabling stable retrieval and generation under challenging visual conditions. To evaluate robustness under realistic conditions, we introduce the Distortion-VisRAG dataset, a large-scale benchmark containing both synthetic and real-world degraded documents across seven domains, with 12 synthetic and 5 real distortion types that comprehensively reflect practical visual degradations. Experimental results show that RobustVisRAG improves retrieval, generation, and end-to-end performance by 7.35%, 6.35%, and 12.40%, respectively, on real-world degradations, while maintaining comparable accuracy on clean inputs.

AI.tldr: RobustVisRAG是一个因果引导的双路径框架，通过分离语义信息和退化信号来提升视觉检索增强生成模型在图像失真条件下的鲁棒性，同时保持零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉检索增强生成模型在图像存在模糊、噪声、低光照或阴影等失真时性能下降，因为预训练视觉编码器会将语义信息和退化因素纠缠在一起，导致检索和生成阶段都出现错误。
AI.method: 提出RobustVisRAG框架，包含非因果路径（通过单向注意力捕获退化信号）和因果路径（在退化信号指导下学习纯化语义），配合非因果失真建模和因果语义对齐目标，实现语义与退化的清晰分离。
AI.result: 在真实世界退化条件下，RobustVisRAG将检索、生成和端到端性能分别提升了7.35%、6.35%和12.40%，同时在干净输入上保持相当的准确性。还构建了Distortion-VisRAG数据集作为大规模基准。
AI.conclusion: RobustVisRAG通过因果引导的双路径设计有效解决了视觉检索增强生成模型在失真条件下的性能退化问题，实现了鲁棒性提升的同时保持了效率和零样本泛化能力。

title: Olbedo: An Albedo and Shading Aerial Dataset for Large-Scale Outdoor Environments
summary: Intrinsic image decomposition (IID) of outdoor scenes is crucial for relighting, editing, and understanding large-scale environments, but progress has been limited by the lack of real-world datasets with reliable albedo and shading supervision. We introduce Olbedo, a large-scale aerial dataset for outdoor albedo--shading decomposition in the wild. Olbedo contains 5,664 UAV images captured across four landscape types, multiple years, and diverse illumination conditions. Each view is accompanied by multi-view consistent albedo and shading maps, metric depth, surface normals, sun and sky shading components, camera poses, and, for recent flights, measured HDR sky domes. These annotations are derived from an inverse-rendering refinement pipeline over multi-view stereo reconstructions and calibrated sky illumination, together with per-pixel confidence masks. We demonstrate that Olbedo enables state-of-the-art diffusion-based IID models, originally trained on synthetic indoor data, to generalize to real outdoor imagery: fine-tuning on Olbedo significantly improves single-view outdoor albedo prediction on the MatrixCity benchmark. We further illustrate applications of Olbedo-trained models to multi-view consistent relighting of 3D assets, material editing, and scene change analysis for urban digital twins. We release the dataset, baseline models, and an evaluation protocol to support future research in outdoor intrinsic decomposition and illumination-aware aerial vision.

AI.tldr: Olbedo是一个大规模航拍数据集，用于户外场景的本征图像分解，包含5,664张无人机图像，提供多视角一致的反射率、阴影、深度、法线等标注，支持户外IID模型训练和应用。
AI.motivation: 户外场景的本征图像分解对于重光照、编辑和理解大规模环境至关重要，但现有研究受到缺乏真实世界数据集（包含可靠的反射率和阴影监督）的限制。
AI.method: 通过多视角立体重建和校准的天空光照，采用逆渲染细化流程生成标注，包括多视角一致的反射率、阴影图、度量深度、表面法线、太阳和天空阴影分量、相机位姿等。
AI.result: Olbedo数据集使基于扩散的IID模型能够泛化到真实户外图像：在Olbedo上微调显著提高了在MatrixCity基准测试上的单视角户外反射率预测性能。
AI.conclusion: Olbedo数据集支持户外本征分解和光照感知航拍视觉的未来研究，并展示了在3D资产的多视角一致重光照、材质编辑和城市数字孪生场景变化分析中的应用潜力。

title: RT-RMOT: A Dataset and Framework for RGB-Thermal Referring Multi-Object Tracking
summary: Referring Multi-Object Tracking has attracted increasing attention due to its human-friendly interactive characteristics, yet it exhibits limitations in low-visibility conditions, such as nighttime, smoke, and other challenging scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose a new RGB-Thermal RMOT task, named RT-RMOT, which aims to fuse RGB appearance features with the illumination robustness of the thermal modality to enable all-day referring multi-object tracking. To promote research on RT-RMOT, we construct the first Referring Multi-Object Tracking dataset under RGB-Thermal modality, named RefRT. It contains 388 language descriptions, 1,250 tracked targets, and 166,147 Language-RGB-Thermal (L-RGB-T) triplets. Furthermore, we propose RTrack, a framework built upon a multimodal large language model (MLLM) that integrates RGB, thermal, and textual features. Since the initial framework still leaves room for improvement, we introduce a Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) strategy to further exploit the model's potential. To alleviate training instability during RL fine-tuning, we introduce a Clipped Advantage Scaling (CAS) strategy to suppress gradient explosion. In addition, we design Structured Output Reward and Comprehensive Detection Reward to balance exploration and exploitation, thereby improving the completeness and accuracy of target perception. Extensive experiments on the RefRT dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed RTrack framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RT-RMOT任务，将RGB与热成像模态融合实现全天候多目标跟踪，构建首个RGB-热成像多目标跟踪数据集RefRT，并提出基于MLLM的RTrack框架及GSPO优化策略。
AI.motivation: 现有的Referring Multi-Object Tracking在低能见度条件下（如夜间、烟雾等）表现受限，需要融合RGB外观特征与热成像的照明鲁棒性来实现全天候跟踪。
AI.method: 1. 提出RT-RMOT任务，融合RGB和热成像模态；2. 构建RefRT数据集（388个语言描述，1,250个跟踪目标，166,147个L-RGB-T三元组）；3. 提出RTrack框架，基于多模态大语言模型整合RGB、热成像和文本特征；4. 引入Group Sequence Policy Optimization策略；5. 使用Clipped Advantage Scaling抑制梯度爆炸；6. 设计结构化输出奖励和综合检测奖励。
AI.result: 在RefRT数据集上的大量实验证明了RTrack框架的有效性，能够实现全天候的RGB-热成像多目标跟踪。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过融合RGB和热成像模态，解决了低能见度条件下的多目标跟踪问题，提出的RTrack框架和优化策略在RefRT数据集上表现出色，为全天候Referring Multi-Object Tracking提供了有效解决方案。

title: SPGen: Stochastic scanpath generation for paintings using unsupervised domain adaptation
summary:
Understanding human visual attention is key to preserving cultural heritage We introduce SPGen a novel deep learning model to predict scanpaths the sequence of eye movementswhen viewers observe paintings.
  Our architecture uses a Fully Convolutional Neural Network FCNN with differentiable fixation selection and learnable Gaussian priors to simulate natural viewing biases To address the domain gap between photographs and artworks we employ unsupervised domain adaptation via a gradient reversal layer allowing the model to transfer knowledge from natural scenes to paintings Furthermore a random noise sampler models the inherent stochasticity of eyetracking data.
  Extensive testing shows SPGen outperforms existing methods offering a powerful tool to analyze gaze behavior and advance the preservation and appreciation of artistic treasures.

AI.tldr: SPGen是一种新颖的深度学习模型，用于预测观察绘画时的眼动扫描路径，通过域适应技术将自然场景知识迁移到艺术作品分析中。
AI.motivation: 理解人类视觉注意力对于文化遗产保护至关重要，但现有方法在分析艺术作品时存在域差距问题，需要专门针对绘画的眼动预测模型。
AI.method: 采用全卷积神经网络架构，包含可微分的注视点选择和可学习的高斯先验来模拟自然观看偏差；使用梯度反转层进行无监督域适应，将自然场景知识迁移到绘画分析；通过随机噪声采样器模拟眼动数据的固有随机性。
AI.result: 广泛测试表明SPGen优于现有方法，为分析注视行为提供了强大工具，有助于文化遗产的保护和艺术珍品的欣赏。
AI.conclusion: SPGen是一个有效的眼动预测模型，能够成功地将自然场景知识迁移到艺术作品分析，为文化遗产保护和艺术欣赏研究提供了新的技术手段。

title: AutoSew: A Geometric Approach to Stitching Prediction with Graph Neural Networks
summary: Automating garment assembly from sewing patterns remains a significant challenge due to the lack of standardized annotation protocols and the frequent absence of semantic cues. Existing methods often rely on panel labels or handcrafted heuristics, which limit their applicability to real-world, non-conforming patterns. We present AutoSew, a fully automatic, geometry-based approach for predicting stitch correspondences directly from 2D pattern contours. AutoSew formulates the problem as a graph matching task, leveraging a Graph Neural Network to capture local and global geometric context, and employing a differentiable optimal transport solver to infer stitching relationships-including multi-edge connections. To support this task, we update the GarmentCodeData dataset modifying over 18k patterns with realistic multi-edge annotations, reflecting industrial assembly scenarios. AutoSew achieves 96% F1-score and successfully assembles 73.3% of test garments without error, outperforming existing methods while relying solely on geometric input. Our results demonstrate that geometry alone can robustly guide stitching prediction, enabling scalable garment assembly without manual input.

AI.tldr: AutoSew：基于几何的自动服装缝合预测方法，通过图神经网络和最优传输求解器直接从2D图案轮廓预测缝合对应关系，无需手工启发式规则或面板标签。
AI.motivation: 服装组装自动化面临挑战，因为缺乏标准化标注协议和语义线索，现有方法依赖面板标签或手工启发式规则，难以处理现实世界中不符合规范的图案。
AI.method: 将问题建模为图匹配任务，使用图神经网络捕捉局部和全局几何上下文，采用可微分最优传输求解器推断缝合关系（包括多边连接）。更新GarmentCodeData数据集，为18k+图案添加真实多边标注。
AI.result: 达到96%的F1分数，73.3%的测试服装能够无错误组装，优于现有方法，仅依赖几何输入即可实现稳健的缝合预测。
AI.conclusion: 几何信息本身足以稳健地指导缝合预测，实现无需人工输入的规模化服装组装，为自动化服装生产提供了有效解决方案。

title: AdaSpot: Spend Resolution Where It Matters for Precise Event Spotting
summary: Precise Event Spotting aims to localize fast-paced actions or events in videos with high temporal precision, a key task for applications in sports analytics, robotics, and autonomous systems. Existing methods typically process all frames uniformly, overlooking the inherent spatio-temporal redundancy in video data. This leads to redundant computation on non-informative regions while limiting overall efficiency. To remain tractable, they often spatially downsample inputs, losing fine-grained details crucial for precise localization. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AdaSpot}, a simple yet effective framework that processes low-resolution videos to extract global task-relevant features while adaptively selecting the most informative region-of-interest in each frame for high-resolution processing. The selection is performed via an unsupervised, task-aware strategy that maintains spatio-temporal consistency across frames and avoids the training instability of learnable alternatives. This design preserves essential fine-grained visual cues with a marginal computational overhead compared to low-resolution-only baselines, while remaining far more efficient than uniform high-resolution processing. Experiments on standard PES benchmarks demonstrate that \textbf{AdaSpot} achieves state-of-the-art performance under strict evaluation metrics (\eg, $+3.96$ and $+2.26$ mAP$@0$ frames on Tennis and FineDiving), while also maintaining strong results under looser metrics. Code is available at: \href{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}{https://github.com/arturxe2/AdaSpot}.

AI.tldr: AdaSpot是一个用于精确事件定位的框架，通过自适应选择关键区域进行高分辨率处理，在保持计算效率的同时提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常对所有帧进行统一处理，忽略了视频数据的时空冗余性，导致在非信息区域进行冗余计算，同时为了保持可处理性而降低空间分辨率，丢失了精确定位所需的关键细节。
AI.method: 提出AdaSpot框架：处理低分辨率视频提取全局任务相关特征，同时自适应选择每帧中最具信息量的感兴趣区域进行高分辨率处理。选择通过无监督、任务感知的策略实现，保持帧间时空一致性，避免可学习替代方案的不稳定性。
AI.result: 在标准PES基准测试中，AdaSpot在严格评估指标下达到最先进性能（例如在Tennis和FineDiving上分别提升+3.96和+2.26 mAP@0帧），同时在宽松指标下也保持强劲结果。
AI.conclusion: AdaSpot通过自适应区域选择策略，以边际计算开销保留了关键的细粒度视觉线索，相比仅使用低分辨率的基线方法显著提升性能，同时比统一高分辨率处理更高效。

title: GeoDiv: Framework For Measuring Geographical Diversity In Text-To-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are rapidly gaining popularity, yet their outputs often lack geographical diversity, reinforce stereotypes, and misrepresent regions. Given their broad reach, it is critical to rigorously evaluate how these models portray the world. Existing diversity metrics either rely on curated datasets or focus on surface-level visual similarity, limiting interpretability. We introduce GeoDiv, a framework leveraging large language and vision-language models to assess geographical diversity along two complementary axes: the Socio-Economic Visual Index (SEVI), capturing economic and condition-related cues, and the Visual Diversity Index (VDI), measuring variation in primary entities and backgrounds. Applied to images generated by models such as Stable Diffusion and FLUX.1-dev across $10$ entities and $16$ countries, GeoDiv reveals a consistent lack of diversity and identifies fine-grained attributes where models default to biased portrayals. Strikingly, depictions of countries like India, Nigeria, and Colombia are disproportionately impoverished and worn, reflecting underlying socio-economic biases. These results highlight the need for greater geographical nuance in generative models. GeoDiv provides the first systematic, interpretable framework for measuring such biases, marking a step toward fairer and more inclusive generative systems. Project page: https://abhipsabasu.github.io/geodiv

AI.tldr: GeoDiv框架通过SEVI和VDI两个指标评估文本到图像模型的地理多样性，发现主流模型在描绘不同国家时存在系统性偏见，特别是对发展中国家呈现贫困化倾向。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型输出缺乏地理多样性，强化刻板印象，错误表征地区，而现有多样性指标依赖人工数据集或仅关注表面视觉相似性，解释性有限。
AI.method: 提出GeoDiv框架，利用大语言模型和视觉语言模型从两个互补维度评估地理多样性：社会经济视觉指数（SEVI）捕捉经济相关线索，视觉多样性指数（VDI）测量主要实体和背景的变异。
AI.result: 对Stable Diffusion和FLUX.1-dev等模型在10个实体和16个国家生成的图像分析显示，模型输出缺乏多样性且存在系统性偏见，特别是对印度、尼日利亚、哥伦比亚等国家的描绘过度贫困和破旧。
AI.conclusion: 生成模型需要更多地理细微差别，GeoDiv提供了首个系统化、可解释的框架来测量此类偏见，是迈向更公平、更具包容性生成系统的一步。

title: WeaveTime: Stream from Earlier Frames into Emergent Memory in VideoLLMs
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 (preview; camera-ready in preparation)
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models have greatly improved visual understanding and reasoning, yet their quadratic attention and offline training protocols make them ill-suited for streaming settings where frames arrive sequentially and future observations are inaccessible. We diagnose a core limitation of current Video-LLMs, namely Time-Agnosticism, in which videos are treated as an unordered bag of evidence rather than a causally ordered sequence, yielding two failures in streams: temporal order ambiguity, in which the model cannot follow or reason over the correct chronological order, and past-current focus blindness where it fails to distinguish present observations from accumulated history. We present WeaveTime, a simple, efficient, and model agnostic framework that first teaches order and then uses order. We introduce a lightweight Temporal Reconstruction objective-our Streaming Order Perception enhancement-that instills order aware representations with minimal finetuning and no specialized streaming data. At inference, a Past-Current Dynamic Focus Cache performs uncertainty triggered, coarse-to-fine retrieval, expanding history only when needed. Plugged into exsiting Video-LLM without architectural changes, WeaveTime delivers consistent gains on representative streaming benchmarks, improving accuracy while reducing latency. These results establish WeaveTime as a practical path toward time aware stream Video-LLMs under strict online, time causal constraints. Code and weights will be made publicly available. Project Page: https://zhangyl4.github.io/publications/weavetime/

AI.tldr: WeaveTime是一个简单高效的框架，通过时间感知训练和动态缓存机制，解决视频大语言模型在流式场景下的时间无关性问题，提升时序推理能力同时降低延迟。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型虽然视觉理解能力有所提升，但其二次注意力机制和离线训练协议使其不适合流式场景。核心问题是时间无关性，即视频被当作无序证据包而非因果有序序列处理，导致时序顺序模糊和过去-当前焦点盲区。
AI.method: WeaveTime框架包含两个核心组件：1) 轻量级时序重构目标（流式顺序感知增强），通过最小化微调和无需专门流式数据来注入顺序感知表示；2) 过去-当前动态焦点缓存，在推理时执行不确定性触发的粗到细检索，仅在需要时扩展历史记录。
AI.result: 在代表性流式基准测试中，WeaveTime无需架构修改即可为现有视频大语言模型带来一致性能提升，提高准确性的同时降低延迟。
AI.conclusion: WeaveTime为在严格在线、时间因果约束下实现时间感知的流式视频大语言模型提供了实用路径，通过教导模型理解顺序并利用顺序来解决时间无关性问题。

title: CoLoGen: Progressive Learning of Concept`-`Localization Duality for Unified Image Generation
summary: Unified conditional image generation remains difficult because different tasks depend on fundamentally different internal representations. Some require conceptual understanding for semantic synthesis, while others rely on localization cues for spatial precision. Forcing these heterogeneous tasks to share a single representation leads to concept`-`localization representational conflict. To address this issue, we propose CoLoGen, a unified diffusion framework that progressively learns and reconciles this concept`-`localization duality. CoLoGen uses a staged curriculum that first builds core conceptual and localization abilities, then adapts them to diverse visual conditions, and finally refines their synergy for complex instruction`-`driven tasks. Central to this process is the Progressive Representation Weaving (PRW) module, which dynamically routes features to specialized experts and stably integrates their outputs across stages. Experiments on editing, controllable generation, and customized generation show that CoLoGen achieves competitive or superior performance, offering a principled representational perspective for unified image generation.

AI.tldr: CoLoGen是一个统一的扩散框架，通过渐进式学习解决概念-定位表示冲突，在图像编辑、可控生成和定制生成任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 统一的图像生成面临根本挑战：不同任务需要不同的内部表示。语义合成需要概念理解，而空间精度需要定位线索。强制这些异构任务共享单一表示会导致概念-定位表示冲突。
AI.method: 提出CoLoGen框架，采用分阶段课程学习：1) 建立核心概念和定位能力；2) 适应多样化视觉条件；3) 为复杂指令驱动任务优化协同。核心是渐进表示编织(PRW)模块，动态路由特征到专门专家并稳定整合输出。
AI.result: 在编辑、可控生成和定制生成任务上的实验表明，CoLoGen实现了竞争性或优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: CoLoGen为统一图像生成提供了一个原则性的表示视角，通过渐进式学习和调和概念-定位二元性来解决表示冲突问题。

title: CASR: A Robust Cyclic Framework for Arbitrary Large-Scale Super-Resolution with Distribution Alignment and Self-Similarity Awareness
summary: Arbitrary-Scale SR (ASISR) remains fundamentally limited by cross-scale distribution shift: once the inference scale leaves the training range, noise, blur, and artifacts accumulate sharply. We revisit this challenge from a cross-scale distribution transition perspective and propose CASR, a simple yet highly efficient cyclic SR framework that reformulates ultra-magnification as a sequence of in-distribution scale transitions. This design ensures stable inference at arbitrary scales while requiring only a single model. CASR tackles two major bottlenecks: distribution drift across iterations and patch-wise diffusion inconsistencies. The proposed SDAM module aligns structural distributions via superpixel aggregation, preventing error accumulation, while SARM module restores high-frequency textures by enforcing autocorrelation and embedding LR self-similarity priors. Despite using only a single model, our approach significantly reduces distribution drift, preserves long-range texture consistency, and achieves superior generalization even at extreme magnification.

AI.tldr: CASR提出了一种循环超分辨率框架，通过将任意尺度超分重构为一系列在分布内的尺度转换，解决了跨尺度分布偏移问题，仅需单个模型即可实现稳定推理。
AI.motivation: 任意尺度超分辨率面临跨尺度分布偏移的根本限制：一旦推理尺度超出训练范围，噪声、模糊和伪影会急剧累积。本文从跨尺度分布转换的角度重新审视这一挑战。
AI.method: 提出CASR循环超分辨率框架，将超高倍率放大重构为一系列在分布内的尺度转换序列。引入SDAM模块通过超像素聚合对齐结构分布，防止误差累积；SARM模块通过强制自相关和嵌入低分辨率自相似性先验来恢复高频纹理。
AI.result: 该方法显著减少了分布漂移，保持了长程纹理一致性，即使在极端放大倍数下也能实现优异的泛化性能，仅使用单个模型就超越了现有方法。
AI.conclusion: CASR通过循环框架和分布对齐机制，有效解决了任意尺度超分辨率中的跨尺度分布偏移问题，为稳定、高质量的任意尺度图像放大提供了新思路。

title: Mixed Magnification Aggregation for Generalizable Region-Level Representations in Computational Pathology
summary: In recent years, a standard computational pathology workflow has emerged where whole slide images are cropped into tiles, these tiles are processed using a foundation model, and task-specific models are built using the resulting representations. At least 15 different foundation models have been proposed, and the vast majority are trained exclusively with tiles using the 20$\times$ magnification. However, it is well known that certain histologic features can only be discerned with larger context windows and requires a pathologist to zoom in and out when analyzing a whole slide image. Furthermore, creating 224$\times$224 pixel crops at 20$\times$ leads to a large number of tiles per slide, which can be gigapixel in size. To more accurately capture multi-resolution features and investigate the possibility of reducing the number of representations per slide, we propose a region-level mixing encoder. Our approach jointly fuses image tile representations of a mixed magnification foundation model using a masked embedding modeling pretraining step. We explore a design space for pretraining the proposed mixed-magnification region aggregators and evaluate our models on transfer to biomarker prediction tasks representing various cancer types. Results demonstrate cancer dependent improvements in predictive performance, highlighting the importance of spatial context and understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种区域级混合编码器，用于融合不同放大倍率的病理图像特征，以更好地捕获多分辨率特征并减少每张切片所需的表征数量。
AI.motivation: 当前计算病理学工作流程主要使用20倍放大倍率的图像块，但某些组织学特征需要更大的上下文窗口，且20倍放大会产生大量图像块。需要更准确地捕获多分辨率特征并减少每张切片的表征数量。
AI.method: 提出区域级混合编码器，通过掩码嵌入建模预训练步骤联合融合混合放大倍率基础模型的图像块表征，探索混合放大倍率区域聚合器的预训练设计空间。
AI.result: 在多种癌症类型的生物标志物预测任务中，结果显示癌症依赖性的预测性能改进，突出了空间上下文和理解的重要性。
AI.conclusion: 混合放大倍率方法能够更好地捕获病理图像的多分辨率特征，提高生物标志物预测性能，特别是在需要空间上下文理解的任务中。

title: WHOLE: World-Grounded Hand-Object Lifted from Egocentric Videos
summary: Egocentric manipulation videos are highly challenging due to severe occlusions during interactions and frequent object entries and exits from the camera view as the person moves. Current methods typically focus on recovering either hand or object pose in isolation, but both struggle during interactions and fail to handle out-of-sight cases. Moreover, their independent predictions often lead to inconsistent hand-object relations. We introduce WHOLE, a method that holistically reconstructs hand and object motion in world space from egocentric videos given object templates. Our key insight is to learn a generative prior over hand-object motion to jointly reason about their interactions. At test time, the pretrained prior is guided to generate trajectories that conform to the video observations. This joint generative reconstruction substantially outperforms approaches that process hands and objects separately followed by post-processing. WHOLE achieves state-of-the-art performance on hand motion estimation, 6D object pose estimation, and their relative interaction reconstruction. Project website: https://judyye.github.io/whole-www

AI.tldr: WHOLE方法从第一人称视角视频中联合重建手部和物体在世界空间中的运动，通过生成式先验联合推理手物交互，解决了现有方法独立预测导致的交互不一致和视野外物体处理问题。
AI.motivation: 第一人称操作视频存在严重遮挡和物体频繁进出视野的问题，现有方法通常单独恢复手部或物体姿态，在交互时表现不佳且无法处理视野外情况，独立预测还导致手物关系不一致。
AI.method: WHOLE方法学习手物运动的生成式先验来联合推理其交互关系，在测试时引导预训练先验生成符合视频观测的轨迹，实现手部和物体在世界空间中的联合重建。
AI.result: WHOLE在手部运动估计、6D物体姿态估计及其相对交互重建方面均达到最先进性能，显著优于分别处理手部和物体再进行后处理的方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合生成式重建手物运动，WHOLE有效解决了第一人称视频中手物交互的挑战，实现了更一致和准确的手物关系重建。
